'''Zjek team''' was a strike force of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]]. They took part in an operation to kidnap holovid star [[Janissa Locrin]], following [[Seland' Ir]]'s scheme.
